items.text: Bookmark category sync — new bookmarks and category changes show in the correct column immediately after save (not only in smart collections). Page cache is invalidated and refreshed; stale cache self-heals when allBookmarks and the grid diverge.

Data revision — GET /api/data-revision fingerprints on-disk bookmarks, categories, finders, pages, and settings. The dashboard checks it before using the page cache and when you return to the tab, so server restarts and external edits stay visible.
Stats guided tour — re-enabled on the Stats tab (reset button visible again).
General spacing (B6) — fused General surface uses --config-tab-gap for vertical rhythm between section cards.
Shared tab intro (B7) — .general-tab-intro consolidated into .config-tab-intro across General and list tabs.
Uniform labels (A8) — --config-label-width on forms, Colors, and Keyboard binding rows.
Keyboard row rhythm (A10) — binding rows match list-tab row height and padding.
Persistent empty hints (B11) — Pages, Categories, Tags filter, and Finders keep stable empty-state copy (toggle hidden instead of destroying nodes).
Reduced motion (C15) — broader prefers-reduced-motion coverage: spinners, usage bars, transitions, and more config animations.
Playwright — bookmark category placement, stale-cache bypass, and data-revision API tests.
README, MANUAL, Help & What's new — release notes for v2026.07.02; General Advanced docs no longer reference removed sticky section nav.
